summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow state and local bonds guaranteed by a Federal Home Loan Bank to maintain their tax-exempt status, removing previous time limits and updating safety and soundness requirements for such guarantees.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to restore the tax-exempt status of state and local bonds guaranteed by a Federal Home Loan Bank. By making these bonds tax-exempt, it effectively lowers the tax burden for investors in these specific bonds, which is a form of tax reduction.

The bill permanently restores tax-exempt status for state/local bonds backed by Federal Home Loan Bank guarantees by removing the prior 2010 sunset. This expands a tax expenditure, forgoing federal revenue and thereby increasing the deficit to support municipal borrowing.
